content.title: Akheri Chahar Shomba-A Baseless Tradition
content.subtitle: Learn about other common misconceptions surrounding Safar
content.body:
Safar 1448 AH is nearing its end. In our country, a bid‘ah centered around the last Wednesday of Safar is observed almost nationally. It is the so-called Akheri Chahar Shomba. National newspapers publish special articles about this day, and it is widely publicized along with news of the Safar moon.

An online version of a renowned Bangladeshi daily states:

According to Islamic history, at the beginning of 23 AH, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) became seriously ill. His condition gradually worsened until he could no longer lead the prayer. On the last Wednesday of Safar, he (ﷺ) recovered, performed ghusl, and led the prayer again. The people of Madinah were overjoyed, came to see him, and gave charity and offered prayers of gratitude.

Based on this, those who observe the day celebrate Akheri Chahar Shomba every year on the last Wednesday of Safar. They offer special salah and give charity. They claim that the Companions (may Allah be pleased with them) donated thousands of camels and thousands of dinars after the Prophet’s (ﷺ) recovery.

They also recite special durud not proven from the Prophet (ﷺ) or his Companions. They believe that reciting these durud and dua over water, then drinking or bathing with it, removes illness and protects from calamities.

But the reality is that the incidents and practices associated with this day are not proven by any reliable hadith.

AlKawsar, a monthly magazine supervised by renowned Hanafi scholars, has described these customs as baseless. It states that this fabricated story and practice emerged almost 1,000 years after the era of the Tabi‘un.

Therefore, out of fear of Allah and love for the Messenger (ﷺ), let us refrain from these false, fabricated, baseless innovations.

May Allah protect us all from shirk and bid‘ah. Ameen.

To learn more about this practice through the statements of authentic scholars, visit the Muslims Day blog: https://muslimsday.com/blog/আখেরী-চাহার-সোম্বা-বিদআত/
